title: "Spectrum Fantastic Art Live" event announced
content: Spectrum has announced its first ever convention to celebrate fantastic art. It will take place nearly a year from now, May 18-20, 2012 in Kansas City, Missouri, USA.Called "Spectrum Fantastic Art Live," it will bring together artists and art appreciators from the fields of science fiction and fantasy art, plus comics, concept art and other related visual pop culture. The event is the dream of Arnie and Cathy Fenner, who have published the Spectrum annuals of contemporary fantastic art.Spectrum 16(the book)Spectrum 17Spectrum Fantastic Art Live
